goal.title: All 17 fields: walk to field + gather + walk home, Natro 1:1
goal.summary: All 17 path-out routes pass 3/3. The full loop (walk out, gather, walk home, convert) now passes 3/3 on 16 of 17 fields. Dandelion and Sunflower were fixed at 4:15 AM: the misses came from our test tool gathering for only 20 seconds (one pattern cycle), not from the walk-home code, and both walked home 3/3 with 60-second gathers. Coconut is marked WIP (the crab always spawns there), so the other 16 fields are the target. A full 17-field regression on the newest code is next.

summary: All 17 path-out routes pass. Earlier tonight the full loop (walk out, gather, walk home, convert) passed 3/3 on 16 of 17 fields. A fresh regression on the newest code plus PR #46 (2 loops per field, 60-second gathers, run from 4:55 AM PT) went 13 of 16: Dandelion (0/2) and Spider (1/2) ended pressed into the hedge by the white fence near the hives, and Pine Tree (0/2) drifted into the Rose field on the way home. PR #46 is now merged. Those three are being re-tested on the new code, and a fresh investigator is comparing their walk home against Natro side by side. A 60-minute soak rotating Sunflower, Clover and Rose walked home 14 of 14 times with no deaths or stuck states. Coconut stays WIP (the crab always spawns there).
